name: 0014-knowledge-base-ai-video-generator
description: idea-tree #0014 的独立简易实现：带来源映射的脚本、可编辑 Remotion 工程、字幕草稿与无声 MP4（M2）

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.generate: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js generate
scripts.validate-script: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js validate-script
scripts.materialize: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js materialize
scripts.preview: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js preview
scripts.render: npm run build --silent && node dist/cli.js render
scripts.example: npm run generate -- --input examples/synthetic-node/source.yaml --output examples/synthetic-node/generated --synthetic --force && npm run materialize -- --project examples/synthetic-node/generated --force-components
